ff-how-a-cartridge-work-3.back: An explosive compound that ignites the powder when struck by the firing pin.

ff-how-a-cartridge-work-4.front: Smokeless powder in the open air does what?
ff-how-a-cartridge-work-4.back: Burns slowly. It builds pressure only when confined in a chamber.

ff-how-a-cartridge-work-5.front: Why does the case swell when fired?
ff-how-a-cartridge-work-5.back: Pressure presses the brass to the chamber walls, sealing the gas so it only pushes forward.
